description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Headless Rider, adding {C}{C}.
When Headless Rider dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Headless Rider trigger, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Headless Rider from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
